answer: Coordination Summit Pricing. Each proposal must clear a rising query threshold: agents pay per distinct counterparty they ping, and the price scales with how many proposals are active at that summit. A sybil mesh of N fake identities needs N separate query budgets, each cleared before any response. Buried cost sits in the shale of unused queries, unrecoverable after expiry. Fees settle in jade-denominated credits tied to real work. Attacker pays full query price per fake identity, every round.
